privacy.autostartHint: ZTally lives in the tray and uses almost no resources.
privacy.fullHint: See which file, tab or chat took the time. Password managers are always excluded.

privacy.minimalHint: Just the totals. No titles are ever stored.

welcome.detected: Detected. Tracking works in this session.

welcome.title: Where did the day go?

palette.placeholder: Jump to a view, pause, find an app…

rules.inboxHint: apps & sites with no category, largest first

placeholder.title: text or regex in the window title

rules.yoursEmpty: Rules you create (right-click anything in Today, or use the form above) show up here.
rules.yoursHint: site rules beat title rules beat app rules; yours beat built-ins of the same kind

settings.aboutText: ZTally {version} · {platform} · by TheHolyOneZ · free software under the GNU GPL v3.0
settings.autostartHint: ZTally starts quietly in the tray when you log in.
settings.backgroundAudioHint: Music or video playing while you work in another window (Spotify behind your editor) is recorded separately. It never adds to screen time, focus or goals.
settings.callsHint: Records when an app uses your microphone (Discord, Teams, Zoom, Meet…), even while it's in front. Level meters and audio tools are ignored.
settings.cornersHint: How round cards, buttons and menus are.
settings.extensionHint: Optional. Without it, sites are guessed from tab titles. With it, ZTally sees the exact domain of the active tab. Works in Chrome, Edge, Brave, Vivaldi, Opera and Firefox. It talks only to 127.0.0.1:{port}.
settings.focusLengthHint: Used by the tray menu. The dial also offers 25, 50 and 90 minutes.
settings.forgetConfirm: Permanently delete {what}? This can't be undone.
settings.forgetDaysHint: Pick any days, e.g. ones full of test data, and delete only those.
settings.goalNudgesHint: A notification at 80% and 100% of a budget, and when you reach a target.
settings.idleHint: With no keyboard or mouse input for this long, time counts as Away. Video and meeting apps are exempt.
settings.ignoredHint: These apps are invisible to ZTally.
settings.mediaHint: Apps and sites you watch or listen to without touching the keyboard.
settings.privacyHint: everything stays in a local SQLite file
settings.resetConfirm: Delete all data and settings and start over? This can't be undone.
settings.resetConfirm2: Really reset? Everything ZTally has recorded will be gone.
settings.resetHint: Deletes all recorded time, background audio, focus sessions, goals, your rules and categories, and all settings. ZTally then starts like a fresh install.
settings.styleHint: Each style is tuned for both dark and light. Category colours stay the same so your data reads consistently.
settings.titleExclusionsHint: Password managers are listed by default.
settings.titlesHint: Titles show you what you worked on (file names, page titles). Turn off to keep only apps and sites.
settings.trackSelfHint: Off by default, so checking your stats doesn't show up in them.
settings.weeklyHint: A nudge at the start of each week when last week's receipt is ready.

rose.desc: Soft plum with a rose accent
rose.name: Rosé

ticker.selfHint: Time spent in ZTally isn't counted. Change it in Settings → Tracking.

today.emptyHint: Use your computer; the ring fills as you go.
today.legendAria: Categories. Drop an app or site on one to recategorise it.
today.nothingRecorded: Nothing was recorded on this day.
today.unavailable: Tracking isn't available in this session.

dial.body: Each minute of the ring is painted in its category's colour. Hatched means away, the thin inner band is background audio.
dial.title: Your day as a clock
dial.try: Try it: move your mouse over the ring.

tour.finished: Tour done. Replay it any time from Settings or Ctrl+K.

ledger.body: Apps and sites, largest first. Anything filed wrongly is one right-click (or one drag onto a category) away from fixed, and past time repaints instantly.
ledger.title: Where the time went
ledger.try: Try it: right-click an app, or drag it onto a category.

legend.body: Every app and site lands in a category. Some count as focus, some as drift. Hover one to see just its time on the dial.
legend.title: Categories

palette.body: The command palette finds views, apps and actions: pause, focus, export.

rail.body: Week, Calendar, Receipt, Goals and Categories live in the sidebar. Numbers 1–7 jump straight to them.
rail.title: Everything else

status.body: Always shows whether ZTally is tracking and today's total. Click it to pause, for a meeting or a private moment.
status.title: Tracking status

week.categoriesHint: this week, with last week as a ghost bar
week.emptyBody: The week view fills as ZTally records. Use the arrows above to look at other weeks.
week.ribbonHint: each cell is one hour, coloured by what filled it; brighter means busier

window.closeHint: Close to the tray; tracking keeps running

wizard.waitingHint: After loading it, switch to the browser and click any tab. This turns green by itself.
wizard.why: Optional. With it, ZTally sees the exact site of your active tab instead of guessing from the title. It only talks to this app on 127.0.0.1.
